title: Get Started with atlantio
text: goal atlantio easily manipulate Atlantis models (Audzijonyte et al. 2019). means reading, editing validating Atlantis inputs outputs (atlantis + /o = atlantio). major initial objective working package able readily set semi-automatic calibration Lake Erie model using calibrar described Morell et al. (2026). vignette quick tour package currently : build Atlantis object input output files, read write .prm parameter files, extract time series biomass tables model outputs, derive diet tables food webs biology parameters, list Atlantis parameters, generate template files prepare calibration.

title: Get Started with atlantio
text: .prm files main way configure Atlantis. read_prm() parses named list every entry keeps comments attribute, write_prm() reverse. makes easy edit parameters programmatically write new file. Pass path file write disk instead console.
code: prm <- read_prm(atlantis_examples("inputs", "tiny_run.prm")) length(prm) #> [1] 82 prm$tstop #> [1] 365 #> attr(,"comments") #> [1] "day # 1-year run; set 5 day for a quick smoke test"  prm$tstop <- 730 write_prm(prm[c("tstop", "dt", "toutstart", "toutinc")]) #> tstop 730 #> # hour #> dt 12 #> # day #> toutstart 0 #> # day #> toutinc 5

title: Get Started with atlantio
text: create_time_series() extracts variable main output tidy data frame, optionally restricted set boxes layers. Time seconds since start run. create_time_series_biomass() gathers reserve structural nitrogen, numbers weight age-structured group, per box, layer age class.
code: names(mod@main_output$var) |> head(10) #>  [1] "volume"     "hdsource"   "hdsink"     "eflux"      "vflux"      #>  [6] "porosity"   "nominal_dz" "dz"         "topk"       "numlayers"  mod |>   create_time_series(variable = "Temp", box = 2, layer = 1) |>   head() #>      time box layer value variable           units #> 1       0   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius #> 2  432000   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius #> 3  864000   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius #> 4 1296000   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius #> 5 1728000   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius #> 6 2160000   2     1    15     Temp degrees Celcius ts_yph <- mod |> create_time_series_biomass(group = "YPH") head(ts_yph) #> # A tibble: 6 × 10 #>      time   box layer group        age    ResN StructN    Nums    weight units #>     <dbl> <dbl> <int> <chr>        <chr> <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl>     <dbl> <chr> #> 1       0     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g     #> 2  432000     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g     #> 3  864000     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g     #> 4 1296000     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g     #> 5 1728000     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g     #> 6 2160000     0     1 Yellow_Perch 1      207.    78.0 308824. 10028845. g library(ggplot2) ts_yph |>   dplyr::summarise(Nums = sum(Nums), .by = c(time, age)) |>   ggplot(aes(x = time / 86400, y = Nums, colour = age)) +   geom_line() +   labs(x = "Day", y = "Numbers", title = "Yellow Perch abundance per age class")

text: biology parameter file contains prey availability matrix (pPREY parameters). create_diet_table() reshapes prey--predator table. create_foodweb() goes one step returns binary food web igraph object, ready network analysis plotting.
code: diet <- create_diet_table(mod) dim(diet) #> [1] 20 18 diet[1:6, 1:6] #>              WAE YPH  GZS RDG DRE  CHI #> pPREY1GZS1 0.000 0.0 0.00 0.0   0 0.05 #> pPREY2GZS1 0.000 0.0 0.00 0.0   0 0.05 #> pPREY1GZS2 0.000 0.0 0.00 0.0   0 0.00 #> pPREY2GZS2 0.000 0.0 0.00 0.0   0 0.00 #> pPREY1WAE1 0.001 0.1 0.10 0.1   0 0.10 #> pPREY2WAE1 0.000 0.0 0.01 0.0   0 0.10 fw <- create_foodweb(mod) fw #> IGRAPH 1bb2b14 DNW- 18 62 --  #> + attr: name (v/c), weight (e/n) #> + edges from 1bb2b14 (vertex names): #>  [1] WAE->WAE YPH->WAE WAE->YPH YPH->YPH WAE->GZS WAE->RDG YPH->RDG RDG->DRE #>  [9] WAE->DRE YPH->DRE GZS->CHI RDG->CHI WAE->CHI YPH->CHI CAL->DIA DRE->DIA #> [17] GZS->DIA ROT->DIA CAL->GRN DRE->GRN GZS->GRN ROT->GRN DRE->CAL GZS->CAL #> [25] RDG->CAL WAE->CAL YPH->CAL DRE->ROT GZS->ROT RDG->ROT WAE->ROT YPH->ROT #> [33] CAL->PB  CHI->PB  DRE->PB  ROT->PB  CAL->BB  CHI->BB  DRE->BB  RDG->BB  #> [41] ROT->BB  CAL->DL  CHI->DL  DRE->DL  RDG->DL  ROT->DL  YPH->DL  CAL->DR  #> [49] CHI->DR  DRE->DR  RDG->DR  ROT->DR  YPH->DR  CAL->DC  CHI->DC  DRE->DC  #> [57] RDG->DC  ROT->DC  YPH->DC  #> + ... omitted several edges par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)) plot(   fw,   layout = igraph::layout_in_circle(fw),   vertex.size = 16,   vertex.color = "#f4e0b7",   vertex.frame.color = "grey40",   vertex.label.color = "black",   vertex.label.cex = 0.75,   edge.color = "grey60",   edge.arrow.size = 0.3 )

title: Calibrating Atlantis model with atlantio and calibrar
text: described @morell_ManualSemiautomated_2026, goal using calibrar automate running batch simulations improve model fit also let modellers nodge model right direction. idea run model various time, optionnally revisit set paramters shuffle go. Difficulties exist given tremendous number parameters Atlantis incude. title: Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container — Atlantis
text: S7 class serves comprehensive container components Atlantis ecosystem model, including input parameters, spatial geometry, simulation outputs. class provides structured way organize access various data types produced Atlantis model runs.

title: Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container — Atlantis
code: Atlantis(   geometry = NULL,   run = NULL,   initial = NULL,   biology = NULL,   group = NULL,   physics = NULL,   forcing = NULL,   fisheries = NULL,   harvest = NULL,   main_output = NULL,   biomass_all = NULL,   biomass_box = NULL,   biomass_age = NULL,   biomass_age_annual = NULL,   diet = NULL,   diet_detailed = NULL,   yoy = NULL,   file_paths = NULL,   version = character(0) )

title: Atlantis Ecosystem Model Container — Atlantis
text: geometry [sf object] Spatial geometry geometry (Box Geometry Model) file defining model domain polygons depth layers connectivity. run [list] Run configuration parameters .prm file including simulation settings, timesteps, output specifications. initial [list] Initial conditions .nc file specifying starting biomass, numbers, state variables functional group. biology [list] Biology parameters .prm file including growth rates, mortality, recruitment, physiological parameters functional group. group [data.frame] Functional group definitions specifying species codes, names, group types (vertebrate/invertebrate), model structure. physics [list] Physical oceanographic parameters including mixing, transport, hydrodynamic processes. forcing [list] Environmental forcing data including temperature, salinity, physical drivers vary time. fisheries [list] Fisheries configuration catch time series data commercial recreational fishing activities. harvest [list] Harvest policies management scenarios including fishing mortality rates selectivity patterns. main_output [data.frame] Primary model outputs including biomass abundance time series functional groups aggregated across space. biomass_all [array] Complete biomass snapshots specific time points showing spatial distribution across boxes depth layers. biomass_box [array] Biomass snapshots aggregated box (spatial polygon) functional group time point. biomass_age [array] Age-structured biomass snapshots showing cohort dynamics vertebrate functional groups. biomass_age_annual [array] Annual summaries age-structured biomass data long-term trend analysis. diet [matrix] Diet composition matrix showing predator-prey relationships consumption rates functional groups. diet_detailed [array] Detailed diet matrices temporal, spatial, size-based resolution predation interactions. yoy [array] Snapshot biomass recruits per year. file_paths [dataframe] Data frame listing path input output files. version [character] Atlantis version used.

title: Create Diet Table — create_diet_table
text: Atlantis model, availability prey determined product prey biomass prey choice coefficient pPREY. latter proportion (0 1) prey biomass actually available predator. function finds information model creates diet table collection pPREY values. Atlantis distinguishes prey choice values juveniles adults. distinction exists species ontogenetic stages flag age_structured_prey_XXX set one. Note species first mature age group given XXX_age_mat. Therefore 4 pPREY values per prey-predator combination: pPREY1XXX1: juvenile-juvenile pPREY1XXX2: juvenile-adult pPREY2XXX1: adult-juvenile pPREY2XXX2: adult-adult XXX denotes code prey species. Note realised diet Atlantis depend factor, instance coeficient mum, assuming used functional response (see predcase_XXXX).

title: Read Atlantis inputs and outputs files — read_atlantis_files
text: read_atlantis_files() function implements file processing pipeline handling diverse Atlantis ecosystem model file formats. One several files can processed . Internally, way files processed determined file extension using switch statement: .bgm: Box geometry files → [read_bgm()] .nc: NetCDF files → [read_nc()] .prm: Parameter files → [read_prm_files()] .csv: Group definition files → [read_group_file()] .txt: Various output formats → [read_txt_files()] Basic examination content done determine type file exhaustive validation carried available. Note unknown file types marked "unknown" rather causing crashes, unreadable files marked "read".
